roadmap.title: Establish the farm
roadmap.description: Build the Delivery Cannon, begin farming and decorate your home. Clear pollution and gather artifacts while exploring.

roadmap.title: Expand deliveries and ranching
roadmap.description: Invite Ulf and Diane. Start hatching animals early so the 30-day ownership counter runs while you advance deliveries.

roadmap.title: Finish the colonies and late upgrades
roadmap.description: Bring every colony to Thriving and finish the ending missions. Complete the vault, flight and rapid-seeding challenges.

steps.text: Use the @item{Seed Shooter} on empty crop mounds until you have planted 100 seeds.
Use the @item{Seed Shooter} on empty crop mounds until you have planted 500 seeds.
Use the @item{Seed Shooter} on empty crop mounds until you have planted 1,000 seeds.

achievements.summary: Wash away 10 Noxious Slimes in total.

steps.text: Spray @mechanic{Noxious Slimes} with the @item{Irrigation Hose} until the removal counter reaches 10.

achievements.summary: Wash away 50 Noxious Slimes in total.

steps.text: Spray @mechanic{Noxious Slimes} with the @item{Irrigation Hose} until the removal counter reaches 50.

achievements.summary: Wash away 150 Noxious Slimes in total.

steps.text: Spray @mechanic{Noxious Slimes} with the @item{Irrigation Hose} until the removal counter reaches 150.
Complete the tutorial task to build the @item{Resource Delivery Cannon}.
Cut @mechanic{Noxious Weeds} with the @item{Spike Saw} as you explore, working toward 100 removals.
Cut @mechanic{Noxious Weeds} with the @item{Spike Saw} as you explore, working toward 300 removals.
Cut @mechanic{Noxious Weeds} with the @item{Spike Saw} as you explore, working toward 700 removals.
Place different decorations around your homestead until @mechanic{Coziness} reaches level 1.
Place different decorations around your homestead until @mechanic{Coziness} reaches level 2.
Place different decorations around your homestead until @mechanic{Coziness} reaches level 3.
Break a purple artifact casing at an ancient ruin and collect the artifact inside.

achievements.description: Feed an animal for the first time.
achievements.summary: Give food to one wild animal.

steps.text: Prepare fodder in an @item{Oven} and offer it to wild animals until you have made 1 feeding.
Prepare fodder in an @item{Oven} and offer it to wild animals until you have made 20 feedings.
Prepare fodder in an @item{Oven} and offer it to wild animals until you have made 50 feedings.
Cut @mechanic{Noxious Weeds} with the @item{Spike Saw} as you explore, working toward 1,000 removals.

achievements.summary: Wash away 300 Noxious Slimes in total.

steps.text: Spray @mechanic{Noxious Slimes} with the @item{Irrigation Hose} until the removal counter reaches 300.
Approach wild animals until they flee. Scare ten animals; try approaching both on foot and in your mech.

achievements.description: Hit another player with a spray of water.
achievements.summary: Hit another player with a spray of water.

steps.text: Join or host a multiplayer session and spray another player with the @item{Irrigation Hose}.

achievements.description: Craft a Mod at the Mech Depot.
achievements.summary: Craft one Mod at a Mech Depot.

steps.text: Open the @item{Mech Depot} and craft a Mod from the unlocked Mod recipes.

achievements.description: Craft 10 Mods at the Mech Depot.
achievements.summary: Craft ten Mods at a Mech Depot.

steps.text: Open the @item{Mech Depot} and craft ten Mods from the unlocked Mod recipes.
Use the @item{Seed Shooter} on empty crop mounds until you have planted 1 seed.

achievements.summary: Finish helping Ulf settle into a permanent home.

steps.text: Invite @npc{Ulf} through an @item{Outpost}.
Talk to Ulf each day to unlock more requests. Complete those requests, including building the garden and house.

achievements.summary: Have a daily conversation with Ulf on five days.

steps.text: Build an @item{Outpost} and invite @npc{Ulf}.
Speak with Ulf on five separate in-game days.

achievements.summary: Finish helping Diane settle into a permanent home.

steps.text: Invite @npc{Diane} through an @item{Outpost}.
Talk to Diane each day to unlock more requests. Complete those requests, including building the garden and house.

achievements.summary: Have a daily conversation with Diane on five days.

steps.text: Build an @item{Outpost} and invite @npc{Diane}.
Speak with Diane on five separate in-game days.
Invite @npc{Ulf} at an @item{Outpost} and complete his requests until you can build the @item{Seed Splicer}.
Use the Seed Splicer to combine two normal seeds, then collect the Spliced Seed.
Plant @item{Rabbage} in a mound with @mechanic{Nitrogenic} soil, such as fresh soil in Outset Grasslands.
Water the crop as it grows, then collect the mature harvest.
Collect @item{Abandoned Eggs} near wild animal nests. Mark nests you find and revisit them on later days until you have collected 20 eggs.
After an egg hatches, use your mech to pick up the farm animal.

achievements.summary: Hatch five farm animals from eggs.

steps.text: Place collected eggs into @item{Egg Incubators} and wait for five farm animals to hatch.

achievements.description: Have 10 happy Farm Animals at once.
achievements.summary: Keep ten farm animals happy at the same time.

steps.text: Hatch and keep at least ten farm animals.
Give the animals food, water and enough space, and pet them. Check that ten animals show the Happy state together.

achievements.description: Have 5 rare Farm Animals at once.
achievements.summary: Keep five rare farm animals at the same time.

steps.text: Watch for the large flying @npc{Behemoth}. Follow the light beneath a dropped golden @item{Radiant Egg} and pick up the egg within three days.
Hatch Radiant Eggs in an @item{Egg Incubator} without a lens. Keep the rare animals and hatch more eggs until you own five together.

achievements.description: Put an Accessory on a Farm Animal.
achievements.summary: Equip an accessory on one farm animal.

steps.text: Build an @item{Animal Accessory Studio} and put a farm animal on its couch.
Craft an accessory, leave your mech, and use the @item{P.I.C.K.-Axe} to pick up the accessory and throw it onto the animal.

achievements.summary: Make 5,000 units of path in Pathmaker Mode.

steps.text: Unlock and equip @mechanic{Pathmaker Mode} at the Mech Depot.
Activate Pathmaker Mode and drive over unpainted ground to lay paths until the achievement counter reaches 5,000.

achievements.displayName: I Would Plow Five Hundred Mounds
achievements.description: Plow 500 Mounds in Field Plow Mode.
achievements.summary: Create 500 crop mounds with Field Plow Mode.

steps.text: Unlock and equip @mechanic{Field Plow Mode} at the Mech Depot. Transform, lower the plow, and drive over fresh ground until you have made 500 mounds.

achievements.description: Trip and land on your feet 5 times.
achievements.summary: Recover from five trips by landing the mech upright.

steps.text: Let your mech trip on uneven ground, then use the stabilize action while falling to land on both feet. Make five successful recoveries.
Load sprouts into the @item{Sprout Cannon} and plant them on open ground until you have planted 200. Buy extra sprouts from the merchant when needed.

achievements.displayName: And I Would Plow Five Hundred More
achievements.description: Create 1,000 crop mounds with Field Plow Mode.
achievements.summary: Create 1,000 crop mounds with Field Plow Mode.

steps.text: Unlock and equip @mechanic{Field Plow Mode} at the Mech Depot. Transform, lower the plow, and drive over fresh ground until you have made 1,000 mounds.

achievements.description: Have a Farm Animal for 30 days.
achievements.summary: Keep the same farm animal for 30 in-game days.

steps.text: Keep an animal after hatching and let 30 in-game days pass with that animal still on your farm.
Bring every colony to @mechanic{Thriving} by completing its resource deliveries.
Complete the ending missions that become available after all colonies are Thriving.

achievements.summary: Bring one colony to Recovering status.

steps.text: Send the requested supplies to a colony through the @item{Resource Delivery Cannon} until its status becomes @mechanic{Recovering}.

achievements.summary: Bring one colony to Stabilizing status.

steps.text: Send the requested supplies to a colony through the @item{Resource Delivery Cannon} until its status becomes @mechanic{Stabilizing}.

achievements.summary: Bring one colony to Thriving status.

steps.text: Send the requested supplies to a colony through the @item{Resource Delivery Cannon} until its status becomes @mechanic{Thriving}.
Use the @item{Resource Delivery Cannon} to supply the goods shown in its delivery menu until you reach milestone 1.
Use the @item{Resource Delivery Cannon} to supply the goods shown in its delivery menu until you reach milestone 5.
Use the @item{Resource Delivery Cannon} to supply the goods shown in its delivery menu until you reach milestone 10.
Use the @item{Resource Delivery Cannon} to supply the goods shown in its delivery menu until you reach milestone 14.

achievements.description: Upgrade a tool to its maximum tier.
achievements.summary: Upgrade one mech tool to its final tier.

steps.text: Advance deliveries to unlock the later tool upgrades.
At the @item{Mech Depot}, select one tool and purchase its successive upgrades until no higher tier remains.
Upgrade the @item{Seed Shooter}, equip its @item{Seed Minigun} Mod, and increase the Minigun targeting radius.
Prepare a large field of empty mounds and stock at least 3,000 seeds before starting.
Fire continuously across the empty field, planting the 3,000 seeds within 30 seconds.
Progress through the late delivery milestones and unlock @mechanic{Skyblazer} at the Mech Depot.
Select Skyblazer from your transformation modes and take off.
At the @item{Mech Depot}, unlock and upgrade @mechanic{Skyblazer}, then fit upgraded @item{Hover Thrusters}.
Take off in Skyblazer and keep climbing until your altitude reaches 900 metres.
